name: Mandate Terminated
description:
Authoritative Message emitted after the inherited mandate workflow changes
the mandate to Mandate/Status Terminated and before graceful processing termination is
applied.

When termination follows Mandate Termination Requested, inResponseTo
references that exact Message occurrence.

timestampUs.description: Effective termination timestamp derived from the root causal Timeline Entry.

reason.description: Optional reason copied from the accepted termination request.
